question: How did the twin brothers who gave Twinsburg, Ohio, its name end their lives?
answer: On the same day, of the same illness. Moses and Aaron Wilcox married two sisters, farmed as partners and held their property in common. They offered land for a town square if the settlement took the name Twinsburg. Both died in 1827, within hours of each other, and were buried in one grave.
move: Ask how many ordinary pairs lived and died unremarked beside the famous one.
ask: Whose ordinary lives am I ignoring because one famous case takes all the attention?
source: Twins Days Festival, Community of Twinsburg
